title: Critbot relationship/interpretation policy
description: The second configurable lens (alongside rubric libraries): how a speaker's standing relative to the presenter modifies the interpretation of what they said. A policy maps (relationship-to-presenter × classification) → a treatment (weight, decision-promotion, protective flags). Swappable + user-definable; ship templates.

weights.description: multiplier applied by the speaker's relationship to the presenter

expertiseBoost.description: added when the speaker's expertise matches the item's rubricTag/topic

promoteToDecision.description: relationships whose directives (suggestion/concern) are recorded as decisions

balancing.description: emit protective flags (e.g., a strong below-authority point at risk of being dropped)
